task_text: Catch, self-toss, recatch and deliver: A ball is thrown high into the air when the episode starts and comes down near the robot. Catch it in the shallow cup the Panda holds, which has one open side. Bring the cup to a launch region and toss the ball straight up out of the cup with a real throw: it must leave the cup floor while rising. Move the cup sideways and catch the ball again. Finally, release it into an open box that slides back and forth along a rail, where it must settle while the box is moving. Phases, in order: initial_catch: The ball first flies free (touching nothing) for at least 25 ms. It then enters the cup from above: its centre crosses downwards through the plane `tool_height` + `radius` = 0.027 m above the cup floor (cup frame) while within `tool_half` - `radius` = 0.048 m of the cup centre in both x and y of the cup frame. After that entry the ball stays in the cup for 0.18 s without interruption. In the cup frame this means: |x| and |y| < `tool_half` - 0.45 x `radius` = 0.0546 m; centre between `radius` - 4 mm = 0.008 m and `tool_height` - 0.12 x `radius` = 0.01356 m above the floor; touched by the cup within the last 25 ms; speed relative to the cup (at the ball's position) < 0.09 m/s.; launch_region: The cup's tool frame comes within 2.5 cm of the launch point (0.30, -0.10, 0.30). The ball is not checked here. The cup position at that moment is recorded as the launch height.; self_toss: All of the following, in this phase. (a) At some step the ball moves upwards faster than 0.2 m/s with its centre more than 0.06 m above the cup height recorded in launch_region. (b) A separation from the cup floor. On a step where the ball touches nothing, within 0.06 s after its last contact with the cup, and with its centre less than `radius` + 12 mm = 0.024 m above the cup floor (cup frame), three things hold. The ball rises faster than 0.2 m/s in the world. Its velocity relative to the cup floor (at the ball's position) along the cup's z axis is more than 0.03 m/s away from the floor. The cup's z axis is within 0.35 rad of vertical. (c) The ball then touches nothing (neither the cup nor anything else) from that separation on. Any contact cancels the separation and a new one is needed. At least 0.06 s after the separation, with (a) already recorded, the ball's centre is more than `tool_height` + `radius` = 0.027 m above the cup floor, both in the cup frame and in world height above the tool frame's origin. The cup position at the separation is recorded.; displaced_recatch: The cup catches the ball again by the same test as initial_catch: a fresh downward entry through the 0.027 m plane within 0.048 m of centre after at least 25 ms of free flight, then retention in the cup for 0.18 s without interruption. At a step where this catch holds, the cup's tool frame is more than 3 cm horizontally (in world x-y) from its position at the toss separation.; moving_receiver_delivery: The ball rests in the cart. In the cart's frame: |x| and |y| < 0.075 - 0.45 x `radius` = 0.0696 m; centre between 0.008 m and 0.06 - 0.12 x `radius` = 0.05856 m above the cart floor; touched by the cart within the last 25 ms; speed relative to the cart < 0.09 m/s. At the same time the ball does not touch the cup and the cart moves faster than 0.02 m/s, for 0.7 s without interruption. This completes the task. Goal geometry: Launch point (0.30, -0.10, 0.30) for the cup's tool frame, radius 2.5 cm.
episode: one episode, no reset: it ends at the first control step where the task has succeeded (every phase in order) or failed (a failure event, a forbidden contact, a safety-limit violation, an object out of bounds, or the task's horizon of 25 s of simulated time, 2500 control steps), when your time is up, or on a simulator error; the simulated clock advances only with the control steps you run
